answer: A sybil tax holds back the tide of fake identities: each new identity pays a one-time tax of 10 POA, burned on payment. An atlas maps every identity to its receipt, so one payment cannot open a second account. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 10 = 1,000 POA, and the sunk tax cannot be recycled, so cost grows linearly. An honest agent pays once and earns it back in 20 epochs in the lagoon of jobs, so honest participation stays cheap.
